Docs-only change: two link swaps plus a U+2019 → U+0027 apostrophe normalization in three files. No build/runtime impact, but two substantive problems. (1) The security.md link is still dead: https://wiki.ubuntu.com/Full_Disk_Encryption_Howto_2019 returns HTTP 404 (verified by fetching). The old help.ubuntu.com URL now 301-redirects to that same 404 — legacy community-wiki pages were not all carried into the new MediaWiki-based wiki.ubuntu.com (its own main page says "legacy content may be unavailable"). The PR should point at a live page instead, e.g. https://documentation.ubuntu.com/security/security-features/storage/encryption-full-disk/ (verified resolving) or the archived wiki content (github.com/ubuntu/wiki-archives). (2) The apostrophe normalization does not match its stated rationale. Stock proselint has no check that flags U+2019; its typography.symbols.curly_quotes check does the opposite — it flags straight "double quotes" and recommends curly ones (proselint/checks/typography/symbols.py), so prose like manage-machine-groups.md:430 ("team A can only deploy machines in pool X.") would still be flagged. The repo has no proselint config or CI usage anywhere (repo-wide grep: zero matches; docs linting per docs/Makefile is pymarkdownlnt + vale + pa11y). Net result: the three converted files mix straight apostrophes with curly “ ” on the same lines, 36 docs/ files still contain U+2019/U+2018 (including deploying-machines.md, also touched here), so the tree is left more inconsistent, not compliant. Either define the quote convention once (config + repo-wide sweep, including “ ”) or drop the partial conversion. Verified good: the Juju swap — juju.is redirects to https://canonical.com/juju, which resolves. Minor: pre-existing typos sit on lines this PR already edits (use-cases 15, 31, 71) and could be fixed in the same pass.
